messages:
maria: Heads-up — our last canary (v3.6 -> v3.7) auto-ramped to 10% and we saw a latency blip for a handful of tenants. Noticed token cost per call also spiked for some prompts. Thinking we should add a composite guard that considers p95 latency, error rate, and token-cost delta before further ramp.
kevin: Got screenshots? Which metrics spiked — infra-side or model-side?
maria: infra.latency.p95 for routing-group eu-west increased from ~180ms -> ~420ms for 95th over a 5m window. Error rate stayed ~0.6% but token_cost_per_call jumped ~35% for a small tenant cohort.
rahul: Hm — could be different prompt lengths after model change. Token-cost delta is noisy but useful. We should avoid auto-pausing on short-lived noisy signals.
lina: Agree. Proposal: composite guard = (p95 > 350ms for 5m) OR (error_rate > 1% for 2m) OR (token_cost_increase > 25% over baseline for 10m AND p50 latency > 200ms). If triggered -> soft-pause (reduce traffic to 0% for canary) + notify oncall and owners.
maria: I like the AND for cost so we don't pause on billing noise alone. Need to decide sampling window and percentile. Also need telemetry plumbing for cost-per-token to be real-time enough.
kevin: How fast can we get token-cost computed? Current billing pipeline is ~10–15m delay. We can derive a cheap estimator from request.metadata.tokens * avg_price_per_token per model in realtime. Not exact but good for gating.
inal: (typo) Lina: +1 to estimator. Use estimator for guard decisions, and reconcile with billing offline. Mark guard as "estimator_based" in UI.
ava: We should expose this guard in the rollout UI as a toggle per-rollout and show the contributing signals — p95, error rate, cost_estimator_delta. Users should be able to pick pause_action: [auto_pause, manual_review, throttle_to_5%].
kevin: Example config sketch:
```yaml
rollout: v3.7
traffic_split:
  baseline: 90
  canary: 10
guards:
  - name: composite_cost_latency
    type: composite
    conditions:
      - metric: infra.latency.p95
        op: '>'
        value: 350
        window: 5m
      - metric: infra.errors.rate
        op: '>'
        value: 0.01
        window: 2m
      - metric: model.cost_estimator.delta_pct
        op: '>'
        value: 25
        window: 10m
    combine: any
    actions:
      - action: auto_pause
        notify: [#oncall, owners]
        rationale: 'cost+latency composite guard'
    estimator_based: true
```
maria: That looks fine. Two operational asks: 1) telemetry team to add model.cost_estimator.delta_pct as a derived metric; 2) oncall playbook: fast-check list (recent prompts, top tenants, avg token length) so they can decide to resume quickly.
rahul: I'll add the derived metric (can emit from routing-proxy) and tag it as low-confidence until we validate against billing. Should include sample_rate and noise flags.
lina: UX: show live mini-chart of the three signals in the rollout panel and a one-click "pause and snapshot" that captures traces + KV cache state.
ava: Also add a field 'escalate_after' (e.g., 5m) so auto_pause can be delayed to avoid transient infra flaps.
kevin: Good call. Maybe default escalate_after: 3m and a backoff so repeated short flaps don't keep pausing.
maria: Ops: let's target a POC behind feature-flag for next week. Rahul — can you produce a sample metric stream? Kevin/Lina — can you wire the UI toggle and pause options? I'll draft playbook.
rahul: On it. Will push a small prometheus exporter in the routing proxy by EOD to backfill test dashboards.
deploy-bot: deploy started: rollout v3.7 -> canary 10% (initiated by maria). sha: a1b2c3.
maria: Thanks. Keep eyes on infra.latency.p95 and model.cost_estimator.delta_pct. If we hit composite guard in staging, test the auto-pause path and verify notifications.
ava: Noted. I'll add the UI mock and label as opt-in. :white_check_mark:
kevin: One more: we should log the guard decision payloads (metric snapshots + config id) into audit logs so we can replay and analyze false positives.
lina: Agreed — audit trail required for postmortems.
maria: Perfect. If no objections, I'll open a GH issue with the config + playbook and tag owners.
kevin: No objections. :thumbsup:
rahul: LGTM.
ava: LGTM.
